sentences.en: Algeria still doesn't have a productive, diversified and modern economy.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚仍然没有一个生产性的、多样化且现代化的经济。

sentences.en: Algeria needs to transform its big desert into productive lands.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚需要把大片沙漠变成肥沃的土地。

sentences.en: Algeria needs to explode the productive efficiency of its workers.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚需要提高工人的生产效率。

senses.zh: 能生产的；生产的，生产性的；多产的；富有成效的
